quotations.text: ∃ G, agreement T S G = true ∧ G.length ≤ F.length ∧ Refines G (pendantPartition S a b) := by
quotations.line_excerpt:
theorem actual_t1_pendant_exchange {T S : Tree} {F : List (List Nat)}
 (hnT : (leaves T).Nodup) (hnS : (leaves S).Nodup)
 (same : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves T ↔ x ∈ leaves S)
 (ha : agreement T S F = true)
 {p : RMAF.Vertex} {a b : Nat} (hc : CoreGraph.CherryAt T p a b)
 (one : (cuts S a b).length = 1) :
 ∃ G, agreement T S G = true ∧ G.length ≤ F.length ∧ Refines G (pendantPartition S a b) := by

quotations.line_excerpt:
def coreLabels (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List Nat :=
 (leaves S).filter fun x => !((cuts S a b).map (subtreeLabels S)).flatten.contains x

quotations.text: if c.paid ≤ budget then some (budget-c.paid) else none
quotations.line_excerpt:
def remaining (budget : Nat) (c : Child) : Option Nat :=
 if c.paid ≤ budget then some (budget-c.paid) else none

quotations.text: (∀ r, (∃ G, solver c r = some G) ↔ ChildWithin T S c r) ∧
quotations.line_excerpt:
def ExactBoundedChild (T S : Tree) (solver : Child → Nat → Option (List (List Nat)))
 (c : Child) : Prop :=
 (∀ r, (∃ G, solver c r = some G) ↔ ChildWithin T S c r) ∧
 (∀ r G, solver c r = some G → ExactChild T S c G ∧ G.length-c.partition.length ≤ r)

quotations.text: [singletonChild S a,pendantChild S a b]
quotations.line_excerpt:
def twoBranches (S : Tree) (a b : Nat) : List Child :=
 [singletonChild S a,pendantChild S a b]
